correctness.rationale: The primary source supplies the rank-one second cohomology and c1=-2[E] calculation for every one-point blow-up. A blow-up biholomorphism must therefore preserve the exceptional cohomology class. If the inverse image of the target exceptional P2 differed from the source exceptional P2, its defining section would restrict to a nonzero section of O_P2(-1), impossible. Thus the exceptional divisor is intrinsic, so the map descends to a pointed base biholomorphism. The converse is functoriality of blow-up. The orbit-counting consequence uses only the checked one-dimensional connected automorphism group.

value.rationale: The source produces exotic Oka complex structures on smooth P3 from arbitrary centres but does not determine whether different centres give the same complex manifold. The accepted result completely resolves that natural moduli question for one point: exactly automorphism-equivalent centres coincide. It upgrades existence to uncountably many pairwise non-biholomorphic Oka complex structures on one smooth manifold and supplies an intrinsic exceptional-divisor recovery mechanism.
